find_largest.title: Finding the largest value
find_largest.big_idea: To find the largest item, keep a 'best so far' and compare every item with it. best only changes when a bigger value turns up, so it is NOT simply the last item in the list.
steps: Start best as the first item.
For each item, if it's bigger than best, replace best.
After the loop, best holds the largest value.
find_largest.sense_check: For [4, 9, 2, 7] the answer can't be 7: 9 was bigger and nothing replaced it.

search_and_count.title: Searching and counting
search_and_count.big_idea: A for loop visits EVERY item, even after it finds a match, unless the code tells it to stop. List positions start at 0.
steps: Trace the loop through every item.
Update the count (or position) each time there's a match.
Remember: the first item is position 0.
search_and_count.sense_check: In [3, 8, 5, 8, 1] there are two 8s, so the count is 2, not 1.
